purpose: Learn which public City Record topics, places, and actions subscribers want to declare.

sampling_frame_request.recipient: Department of Citywide Administrative Services records access officer
sampling_frame_request.reasonably_particular_description: Current voluntary City Record email subscribers eligible for a one-time service-improvement survey.
sampling_frame_request.handling: One-time invitation only; addresses remain outside product analytics and are deleted after the invitation window.

questions: Which public topics do you choose to follow?
Which boroughs or named places do you choose to follow?
Which actions do you want to know about: read, attend, comment, apply, or bid?
How often should a digest arrive?
What useful notice has been hard to find or act on?

ontology_change_log.reason: Existing public watch filters and named routing cases establish a testable baseline before fieldwork.
